items.title: University of Tokyo's Matsuo-Iwasawa Lab launches free 'AX Evangelist' online AI course
items.summary_en: The Matsuo-Iwasawa Laboratory at the University of Tokyo announced a new seven-session, free online course called the 'AX Evangelist Course,' aimed at non-IT professionals across Japanese workplaces. The stated goal is to help organizations move beyond individual employees using AI tools toward organization-wide AI adoption ('AX').
items.source_name: Matsuo-Iwasawa Laboratory, The University of Tokyo
items.notes: Original in Japanese; translated by collector. Direct fetch of weblab.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp was blocked by the network egress proxy this run; content reconstructed from a Google-indexed search snippet of the official page title/summary, not independently verified via full-text fetch. items.title: University of Tokyo holds kickoff symposium for 'AIR/E' social-collaboration course on responsible AI ethics with SoftBank
items.summary_en: The University of Tokyo's Graduate School of Interdisciplinary Information Studies held a kickoff symposium for a new social-collaboration course, 'Developing Responsible AI Ethics for a Sustainable Future' (AIR/E), established with SoftBank. An associated eight-part public lecture series covering AI governance, copyright/law, environmental impact of AI, and international rulemaking is scheduled to run September-December 2026.
items.source_name: The University of Tokyo (official site, Japanese)
